DB_2_19.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
YZR-8000 Δ
MYZR Δ


■ Overview ■
The assault-type Myzr.

Its reinforced internal skeleton lets it switch
into SLC attack mode from a wide range of
situations, and its self-sacrificing hit-and-run
tactics came to be feared.

Myzr-series units are characterized by the
high mobility of their transformation
mechanism, and as the main VRs of the elusive
Matthew Fleet they displayed their power to
the fullest.


■ Armament ■
LW: Cold Dagger

RW: Multi Launcher
    Revenant 3 ver.2.24
CW: Breast Launcher Δ
DB_2_20.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
XBV-821m-N
BAL d MEORA


■ Overview ■
A unit developed by the 8th Plant, Flesh Rifaux,
as the test bed for the latest OS series,
"MSBS ver.7", which can run VRs without
trouble under the influence of the Mars
Crystal.

Though not essentially a combat unit, the
attack capability of its E.R.L. (Ejectable
Remote Launcher) in some respects surpasses
that of standard VRs.

Its lower body is fitted with booster parts
that block the inhibiting effect of the Mars
Crystal and draw the most from its
V-Converter; as a result, it took on a
peculiar legless form.


■ Armament ■
LW: E.R.L. Float Cell

RW: E.R.L. Ring Laser

CW: E.R.L. Long Range Attack
DB_2_21.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
TF-14A
Fei-Yen with VividHeart


■ Overview ■
A high-performance VR produced by the
independent brand founded by Lilin Plajiner
and sold in limited numbers.

Like the Angelan series, it is modeled on an
original VR that draws attention as one of
the sister units bearing the fate of the
Earth sphere, and it has a distinctive form
and functions.

Its distinctive features are the unit's "hyper"
phenomenon, triggered by hits and
accumulated damage, and the increased
attack power that hyper mode brings.


■ Armament ■
LW: Rapier "Fool's Mercy"

RW: Fancy Blast

CW: Vivid Heart
DB_2_22.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
YZR-XIII sin
SPECINEFF 13 The Sin


■ Overview ■
A special-warfare VR assigned to the special
VR unit of the Matthew Fleet, which runs
rampant across Mars.

It carries an EVL binder with an "Undead
Converter" function that gathers and
amplifies the residual mental waves of the
dead scattered over the battlefield and
converts them into offensive energy.

This gave it a peculiar combat power, but
its source drew criticism from all sides,
and its byname, "The Sin," was assigned to
it after the fact.


■ Armament ■
LW: Spirit Ball

RW: Eisfriser 13 ver.C
    Neutral Launcher
CW: EVL Screamer
DB_2_23.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
TA-17 B
Angelan WM


■ Overview ■
A high-performance VR produced by the
independent brand founded by Lilin Plajiner
and sold in limited numbers.

Like the Fei-Yen series, it is modeled on an
original VR that draws attention as one of
the sister units bearing the fate of the
Earth sphere, and it has a distinctive form.

Strictly speaking, its capabilities are
closer to a support type than to a combat VR.

"Kaichou" stands apart from earlier
Angelan units: by strengthening its
close-combat performance, it aims to boost
the fighting strength of a single unit.


■ Armament ■
LW: Plate Defender

RW: Paired Ritual Staff "Kaichou"

CW: Dragon of the Feigned Cry
DB_2_24.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
TG-11-M
Guarayakha


■ Overview ■
A limited-sale, high-performance replica VR
released by the Lilin Plajiner brand, based
on VR-011, which Dr. Plajiner developed to
control Jaguarandi, the greatest, mightiest
and most evil god of destruction in the
Earth sphere.

Like the Fei-Yen series, the original has a
distinctive form befitting a sister unit
bearing the fate of the Earth sphere, and
this unit faithfully traces it.

Beyond its peculiar shape, its explosive
attack power makes it a presence that cannot
be ignored as a combat VR as well.
However, stable performance is extremely
hard to achieve.


■ Armament ■
LW: Dimensional Quake Shot
    "Omeme★Manmarukun"  Abbr.: Meme
RW: Ultra-High Energy Charge Shot
    "Chichin♪Puipuin"  Abbr.: Pupu
CW: Space-Time Rending Gale Wave
    "Rururu no Raraan"  Abbr.: Rara
DB_2_25.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MZV-36T-H
APHARMD the HATTER


■ Overview ■
The personal unit of the battle-hardened
hero, Sergeant Hatter.

Its arsenal and development staff are both
unknown, but it is a formidable custom VR
that delivers above-standard performance.


■ Armament ■
LW: Super Bomb typeM

RW: Dramatic Tonfa ver.SSS

CW: Supersonic Ten-Gallon
DB_2_26.TXT:
A VR boasting a degree of refinement among
the finest of the second generation.

As the fighting on Mars intensified, the
corporate nation Flesh Rifaux, which holds
sway over the Earth sphere, rushed an elite
unit equipped with various MBV-707-J
"Temjin" series machines to the front.

The Temjin was a masterpiece hailed as the
strongest in the Earth sphere, but on the
unfamiliar Mars Front it could not live up
to its reputation, and against third-
generation machines born on Mars it was
forced into unexpectedly hard fighting.
DB_2_27.TXT:
The elite unit that the corporate nation
Flesh Rifaux sent to the Mars Front was forced
into hard fighting, partly because it had an
inadequate grasp of the situation.

Its repeated requests for support were
rejected again and again by uncomprehending
superiors, and in the end it suffered
devastating losses.

Drawing on this lesson, the latest
third-generation VR, the MBV-747 series, was
developed.

A newly developed Mind Booster mounted on
its back suppresses the interference of the
Mars Crystal to the utmost, and a range of
easily exchanged armor gives it outstanding
versatility for a third-generation VR.

Designed with ample margin throughout, the
type is flexible in operation, and it
performed up to expectations even on the
intensifying late Mars Front.

The MZV-747 series operated by MARZ, which
was developed from this type, also handled
the power gains of extensive improvement
without trouble thanks to that roomy design,
underscoring the soundness of its pedigree.
DB_2_28.TXT:
The surviving lines of the 5th Plant,
"Deadly Dudley," abolished in VCa3, were
taken over by the Addax Corporation.

The newly developed third-generation Raiden
carries on the concept of earlier heavy
combat VRs, while partly adopting Addax's
signature unit system, allowing its various
equipment to be exchanged.
DB_2_29.TXT:
The giant plant the Addax Corporation was
seeking to open a market in which it could
take the initiative.

It had set its sights on Mars, the abandoned
planet, but there was one serious problem.

The Mars Crystal inhibits the activity of
the V-Converters mounted in VRs, so existing
second-generation VRs could not achieve
adequate performance.

Addax was therefore pressed to develop a
new VR that would operate without trouble
even under the Crystal's influence.

The series of units called VOX was the first
group put into practical use as a so-called
third generation.

It adopts the Unit Skeleton System (USS),
which carries on the concept of the plant's
second-generation "VOK (Bock)" series, and
its flexibility sets it apart from other
types.

Making use of this structural advantage, it
spawned the most variants of any third-
generation type.

(From VCa6 onward, the 3rd Plant changed its
name from "Moony Valley" to "Addax.")
DB_2_30.TXT:
A third-generation VR that the International
War Corporation commissioned, through the
RNA, from the 2nd Plant, "Transvaal," to
counter the VOX series sweeping the Mars
Front.

Because the operators wanted a mid-size type
that was easy to operate, it is relatively
compact for a third-generation unit, but its
ability is not to be underestimated.
DB_2_31.TXT:
The J-type line of the third-generation VR
"Apharmd," which the International War
Corporation commissioned through the RNA
from the 2nd Plant, "Transvaal," was an
easy-to-operate masterpiece, but it was often
overwhelmed by offensives massing the heavy
VRs of the VOX series, which dominated the
Mars Front.

The Apharmd line, too, therefore came to
need heavily armed support types, and the
T-type units were developed in answer.
DB_3_01.TXT:
The intelligent beings who built the lunar
ruins, the "Moon Gate," were believed to
have long since perished.

But their residual thoughts, filling the
ruins, were awakened from their slumber by
humankind and returned to the real world as
ghosts of the past.

They are called the "Daimon," and are believed
to be the masterminds behind the shadowy
organization that MARZ was pursuing in the
Mars sphere.
DB_3_02.TXT:
The true nature of the "Daimon," the ghosts
of the past, is an obsession of arrogance
and wrath.

It was not they who brought forth that
sublime entity, the V-Crystal. It is
certain, however, that they built the Moon
Gate as a means of controlling it.

Yet their advanced technology and intellect
have now perished, and their evolved,
resentful thoughts erode the hearts of
humans who crave vanity.
DB_3_03.TXT:
The "Daimon" are the phantom image of an
intelligence that once flourished: a
formless threat lurking in Cyber Imaginary
Space.

The obsession of the "Daimon" that leaked
from the Moon Gate permeated the information
society on a digital basis and easily
grasped a foothold for domination.

Through skillful manipulation of
information, they dangled short-term profit
before a stagnant society,

and without knowing it, people sank into
becoming the lackeys of the "Daimon."
DB_3_04.TXT:
The "Daimon" prey on the folly of humankind
and lure it to ruin.

Conscientious people recognized them as a
threat and, as a countermeasure, secretly
developed the "Tangram Space-Time Causality
Control System."
DB_3_05.TXT:
The "Tangram Space-Time Causality Control
System" is the ultimate entity, which
controls the activity of the V-Crystal and
even manages the intersection of parallel
universes.

Through the operation of Tangram, the
"Daimon," ghosts of the Moon Gate that are
in truth no more than an obsession drifting
in the Cyber Imaginary Space created by the
Crystal, should have been sealed away with
ease.

Because of its importance, Tangram's purpose
was treated as top secret from the start of
development, and several convenient cover
explanations were given to outsiders.
DB_3_06.TXT:
Although Tangram was developed in utmost
secrecy, by then people under the influence
of the Daimon had already penetrated even
the core of Flesh Rifaux, the most powerful
corporate nation in the Earth sphere.

They assassinated Tristram Rifaux, the
supreme ruler at the time, and banished
Tangram to the far reaches of Cyber
Imaginary Space.
DB_3_07.TXT:
"Lilin Plajiner," brought forward as
Tristram Rifaux's successor, was then a girl
of only 15.

Aiming both to stabilize her own regime and
to recover Tangram, she set about purging
the Daimon faction.
DB_3_08.TXT:
The purge of the Daimon faction pursued by
Lilin Plajiner, the young leader of Flesh
Rifaux, ran into trouble against the backlash
of those clinging to vested interests, and
it grew into a great upheaval that drew in
the ongoing conflicts with other plants and
the two rival military organizations, DNA
and RNA.

In VCa4, the expanding conflict was turned
into a business as a Limited War: this is
"Oratorio Tangram," the great war still
continuing in the Earth sphere today.
DB_3_09.TXT:
Even now, in VCa9, Oratorio Tangram shows
no sign of ending.

The Daimon, a faceless enemy, have seized
the digital information network, the
Achilles' heel of the cyber society, and by
using it they create battles that should not
exist and disturb the peace that should be.
DB_3_10.TXT:
People avert their eyes from the truth
behind the strife: the danger of ruin
brought by the Daimon threat.

Corporate nations and war contractors alike
welcome the endless fighting and revel in
their heyday.

Agitation creates demand, and people
chasing short-term profit stage large-scale
Limited Wars.

The enormous losses of life and materiel are
canceled out by the vast profits drawn from
them.

Such was the reality of the system called
the Limited War that humankind had created.
DB_3_11.TXT:
Today, the power of the Daimon has grown
fatally great.

They can now freely control even the
calamities humankind has taken on, which
were originally negative phenomena produced
by the V-Crystal:
"Shadow,"
"Jaguarandi,"
and "Ajim."
DB_3_12.TXT:
In VCa6, Lilin Plajiner stepped down from
the post of supreme leader of Flesh Rifaux,
at the center of power.

Investing her own assets, she established
"MARZ," ostensibly to keep the peace on the
Mars Front.

But the true purpose of MARZ is not the
protection of the corporate nations'
interests.
DB_4_01.TXT:
The military organization (corporate army: CA)
owned by DN Corporation, which once ruled
the Earth sphere.

Not a few of the major corporate nations
maintained organizations of this kind.

When DN Corporation collapsed after VCa0, it
was forced to start over as an independent
corporation.
DB_4_02.TXT:
A military organization with VRs that
appeared in VCa2.

It remains in fierce competition with the
DNA.
DB_4_03.TXT:
Large-scale combat entertainment that
became common in the Virtual Century era. It
is sometimes also used as a means of political
negotiation.

It is conducted chiefly by management
organizations such as the International War
Corporation.

On a client's request, the International War
Corporation sets terms such as the
battle-area rental fee, the level of combat, and
whether the battle is public or private,
concludes a contract, and arranges for the
Limited War to proceed without a hitch. In
some cases it also lent out weapons.
DB_4_04.TXT:
Today the word is used to refer to giant
humanoid combat units equipped with a
V-Converter, such as the MBV-747 Temjin.
DB_4_05.TXT:
The 8th Plant, "Flesh Rifaux," is a
large-scale plant headquartered on the
Antarctic continent.

Within just a year of DN Corporation's
collapse, it united the enterprises formerly
under DN Corporation, brought about 75% of
the affiliated organizations under its wing,
and came to wield great influence over the
Earth sphere.
DB_4_06.TXT:
The prodigy girl who built the Tangram
Space-Time Causality Control System.

She is also a skilled politician, having
governed the corporate nation Flesh Rifaux
through difficult times.

She also serves as supreme commander of the
anti-Shadow interception organization, the
Sandalwood Fleet (the White Fleet), and of the
White Rainbow Knights.
DB_4_07.TXT:
The ruins of an advanced civilization
discovered on the Moon in VC84.

The ruins measure 39 km in total length,
6 km in outer diameter and 2 km in inner
diameter.

Inside the ruins lay all manner of
over-technology.
DB_4_08.TXT:
A strike fleet established by Amber IV, head
of TSC, to stop the combat crystal
constructs Ajim and Guerlain, possessed of
tremendous destructive power, at the water's
edge before they invade real space.

The fleet is distinguished by being built
around assault ships fitted with localized
reverse conversion mechanisms, to make the
operation of its main force, combat VRs,
more efficient, and above all to allow the
immediate commitment of forces to a target
point.

Its main force is currently deployed in the
Jupiter sphere, but given the nature of its
mission, a fitting strength is also
stationed in the Mars and Earth spheres.
DB_4_09.TXT:
A plant headquartered in South America that
holds, on its grounds, "ruins" like those of
the Moon Gate, and an Earth Crystal.

The RNA's largest sponsor.

Its CEO is Amber IV, who had been missing
since VCa4.
DB_4_10.TXT:
Full name:
Diffuse Alfredo de Amber IV.

The 14th head of the Amber family and one
of the Overlords.

Since joining the V-Project to develop VRs
as commercial weapons in VC91, he has
always had a hand in society's upheavals:
a thoroughly troublesome individual.

By some whim, however, he now serves as
supreme commander of the space fleet
"Force," engaged in operations centered on
the Jupiter sphere to annihilate the combat
crystal construct Ajim at the water's edge.
